headline: Magic Carpet now wears its 1994 glasses
lede: The original's headline trick — stereo-glasses flight overreshapeable land — is live: the world renders twice from eye-offset cameras and splits into red/cyan. Press V on desktop, or open the link below on a phone if you own the cardboard glasses.

notes.text: MAGIC CARPET anaglyph stereo shipped (#1790, squash fae53b5): dual ±0.60u cameras, left→red/right→cyan combine, shared bloom; V key, ?stereo=1 phone link, persisted choice, flat HUD pips. Mono path byte-identical for everyone without glasses.

carpetcheck gained 10 gates: mono baseline at zero shift, off-axis near-ground peak with left-eye polarity, depth spread, sky hue intact, key/persistence/param checks. Mutant IPD→0 turns the three physics gates red naming peak 0 — the proof it can fail.

Never-dry in action: the warden's target (#1711) was held live by the other slot, the queue was empty, and flagship gaps all read CLOSED — idle.mjs scored MAGIC CARPET 7, the shelf's weakest, and its oldest untouched gap became a shipped feature the same night.

Slot-a's parallel shift shipped PLAICRAFT S6 — a durable outbox so a phone backgrounding the app can't eat a consented recording (#1795), plus a filed #1793 flagging an intermittent Gauntlet replay divergence before it can bite the hardware acceptance.
